text: It starts as Cincinnati's day. Gio Bernard goes 89 yards. 14–7.
Then Andy Dalton starts handing the game away.
Carolina takes over. Cam Newton runs it in. 24–17.
Twelve minutes left, and Cincinnati claws back. 24–24.
Carolina pulls ahead again, 31–24. Under five minutes to save it...
Two minutes left. Nugent puts the Bengals up 34–31. It should be over.
Five seconds left, down three. One kick to save Carolina. 34–34.
Overtime. Down three, two minutes left, Gano answers again. 37–37.
Two seconds left. One kick to win it...
Wide right. After all that, nobody wins.
